pairs.ask: Coach Agent Overlap: Missing handoff replies, Grok Bot chases same day or Coach chases Thursday?

optionA.label: Grok Bot Same Day
optionA.desc: Grok Bot chases any handoff with no reply after a few hours.

optionB.label: Coach Thursday
optionB.desc: Coach lists missing replies in the Thursday review and coaches the agent.

pairs.ask: Coach Agent Overlap: Open handoffs to paused agents, hold them or reassign to Grok Bot?

optionA.label: Hold Them
optionA.desc: Scout and Japan Cottage handoffs wait until those agents are unpaused.

optionB.label: Reassign
optionB.desc: Grok Bot takes any urgent handoff meant for a paused agent.

pairs.ask: Coach Agent Overlap: Rent and property costs, Portfolio books them or Prop tracks them?

optionA.label: Portfolio Books
optionA.desc: Portfolio books rent and costs; Prop sends it receipts and changes.

optionB.label: Prop Tracks

pairs.ask: Coach Agent Overlap: Dashboard audits, Coach on Thursday only or Grok Bot audits too?

optionA.label: Coach On Thursday
optionA.desc: Coach runs the one weekly board check. Grok Bot steps in only for something urgent.

optionB.label: Both Keep Auditing
optionB.desc: Grok Bot keeps its ad-hoc audits (like the 21-board audit) and Coach keeps Thursday.

pairs.ask: Coach Agent Overlap: Push blocked by the page lock, agent re-Locks and Retries or pings Security?

optionA.label: Agent Retries
optionA.desc: The hook already re-locked the page; the agent commits and pushes again.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#0B6E4F"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">BLOCKED PUSH</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Agent Retries</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">The hook already re-locked the page;</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">the agent commits and pushes again.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Ping Security
optionB.desc: The agent stops and posts a handoff so Security checks what was unlocked.
